correctness.rationale: Let u be any nonconstant binary scattered triple, k≥3; host W itself must avoid u and contain every length-k u-avoider. Reversal and complementation reduce six patterns to 001 and 010. For 001 the forced host form 1^a0 1^b0^c and witnesses 1^(k-2)01, 01^(k-1), 0^k imply a≥k−2,b≥k−1,c≥k−1, equality unique; complete decomposition of u-avoiding targets proves coverage of 1^(k−2)0 1^(k−1)0^(k−1). For 010 all zeros are one run, and witnesses impose W=1^(k−1)0^k1^(k−1). Independent exhaustive brute-force over all admissible hosts through minimal bound for k=3,4,5 verified unique winners for both orbit reps. Thus L=3k−4+number of changes in u. Finite checks corroborate, proof covers all integer k≥3.
